gallery.title: File:White Desert, Egypt.jpg
gallery.description: The bizarre rock formations, some rocks look like animals, mushrooms, trees, and some have totally ethereal shapes. White Desert is a site of cliffs, dunes and large white chalk rock formations, created through erosion by wind and sand. White Desert, part of Saharan Libyan Desert, some 30 km to the east of Al-Farafra, Egypt.
categories: Photos by Vyacheslav Argenberg in Egypt
